Maria Sprecher.bio: Maria trained in tai chi and qigong at the ShaoLin Center of Waukesha, where she became a senior instructor. Her background also includes a degree in education and study with Sun Chun Xiang of the Chinese Health Qigong Association.

Sara Neall.bio: Sara has practiced with RIM since 2012 and has studied in early Buddhist and Tibetan traditions. Her practice and writing explore how to live with kindness and joy amid suffering.

Amy Gardner.bio: Amy has practiced mindfulness and meditation since 2008. Drawing on a background in education and yoga, she has shared mindfulness with students and teachers in local schools and taught meditation in the Greater Milwaukee correctional system.

Pam Miller.bio: Pam is a wellness educator with experience teaching yoga, mindfulness, and self-compassion. She holds a master’s degree in curriculum and instruction and has trained in restorative circles. Her work includes sharing practice through nonprofit organizations and the Wisconsin correctional system.

Sam Scherer.bio: Sam began practicing regularly with RIM in 2024 and also helps guide evening meditation. Her interest in nature includes developing caring relationships with the places around us.

Kerry Thomas.bio: Kerry began practicing with RIM in 2018. Her work has brought people together around transportation and care for communities and the Earth. She shares an interest in practicing meditation in nature.

Christine Jacobi.bio: Christine joined RIM in 2020. A retired special education teacher and administrator, she brings a lifelong interest in nature and environmental issues to her practice.
